requirement: Transfer editable HWPX curves between HWPX documents while preserving segment types, coordinates, control-point representation, ownership, resources, and durable serialization.

implementation.scope: IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED for supported same-format HWPX structured curve transfer. This preserves the source editable curve structure and deterministic derived cubic model; it does not establish independent Bezier handle editing or invent control-point serialization.
implementation.behavior: Bounded package export/import transfers the exact supported HWPX segment types, endpoint coordinates, semantic source tree, and deterministic derived cubic model. It preserves supported shape geometry, style, and placement, remaps destination ownership/object/instance/resource IDs, and verifies resource bytes. Unsupported/unknown root, segment, fill, caption, textbox, or resource envelopes are rejected. Destination mutation is snapshot-backed and atomically rolled back on paste failure; floating-object paste preserves the existing +567 HWP-unit cascade.

limits.unsupported: Unknown or ambiguous envelope/resource, captions, textboxes, unsupported nested fill metadata, and unowned/external resources fail closed.

For P6 same-format transfer, the supported source segment/tree and deterministic derived cubic model are reproduced and checked across transfer/save/reopen.
formatContractEvidence.decision: P6-HX-CURVE structured same-format transfer is IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED within the tested supported envelope. Independent Bezier handle editing/serialization is the separate unresolved P4-HX-CURVE requirement; do not invent a HWPX field or claim P4 complete.
